pageSubtitle: Metrics 3–7 — Revenue, Gross Profit, High Margin Penetration, Repeat Order Rate, Customer Expansion

m3.tooltipInfo:
Measures average revenue from repeat customers who keep transacting (Existing Active) in this period — reflecting the economic value of retained customers and the effectiveness of retention and account-growth strategy.

If the Avg line is far above Median, a few large customers are pushing the average up, not even growth across the board. The orange bar marked ⚠ flags a month where 1 customer contributed more than 25% of total revenue. "High Margin Revenue" measures the revenue share from High Margin products that month.

Formula: Avg Revenue = Total Existing Active Revenue ÷ Number of Existing Active.
Existing Active = already had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m3.emptyMessage: No revenue data for this period
m3.summaryExistingInfo: Number of repeat customers who transacted this period.
m3.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest revenue in the current period

m4.sectionLabel: Average Gross Profit per Existing Customer
m4.tooltipInfo:
Measures average gross profit from repeat customers who keep transacting (Existing Active) in this period — the profitability of old customers based on margin contribution, not just revenue.

Each period is split into 3 tiers (Top/Mid/Bottom) based on that period's median individual GP — the customer mix per tier can shift over time. The orange bar marked ⚠ flags a period where 1 customer contributed more than 25% of total gross profit.

Formula: Avg Gross Profit = Total Gross Profit (Revenue − COGS) from Existing Active ÷ Number of Existing Active.
Existing Active = already had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m4.summaryExistingInfo: Number of repeat customers who transacted this period.
m4.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest GP in the current period

m5.tooltipInfo:
Measures how well the company drives sales of high-margin products — the share of repeat customers who keep transacting (Existing Active) who bought at least 1 High Margin product in this period.

This metric measures the share of CUSTOMERS who bought, not the revenue share — many customers buying doesn't always mean the transaction value is large, or the other way around.

Formula: HM Penetration = (Existing Active who bought ≥1 High Margin product ÷ Existing Active) × 100%.
Existing Active = already had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m5.emptyMessage: No Existing Active bought high margin products this period
m5.summaryExistingInfo: Number of repeat customers who transacted this period.
m5.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest high margin product revenue in the current period

m6.tooltipInfo:
Measures customer loyalty — the share of repeat customers who keep transacting (Existing Active) who purchase again within this period, reflecting the quality of the customer experience and the effectiveness of retention strategy.

"Repeat order" here means more than 1 transaction within this period — not just having bought before. The green target line is configured in Settings → Threshold, not always 100%.

Formula: Repeat Order Rate = (Existing Active with >1 transaction this period ÷ Existing Active) × 100%.
Existing Active = already had transaction history before this period, and still transacted during this period.
m6.summaryExistingInfo: Number of repeat customers who transacted this period.
m6.summaryRepeatCountInfo: Customers who shopped more than once this period.
m6.topCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest order count this period
m6.emptyMessage: No Existing Active ordered more than once this period

m7.sectionLabel: Customer Expansion · Spending Up vs Down
m7.tooltipInfo:
Measures business value growth from customers who have not yet crossed the dormant threshold (Customer Base) — the share whose purchases this period are higher than the previous period, reflecting the effectiveness of the account growth and customer value expansion strategy.

Compared against the PREVIOUS period (same width, not the same month last year). A customer who didn't order at all before but orders now still counts as "spending up".

Formula: Expansion Rate = (Customer Base with this period's revenue > previous period's revenue ÷ Customer Base) × 100%.
Customer Base = customers who have NOT crossed the dormant threshold yet (per division business category) — customers already confirmed dormant are excluded from the calculation entirely, not counted in the denominator. The "Inactive" category still shows, but only for customers who recently went quiet, not past the threshold yet.
m7.chartSubtitle: Green = spending up · Grey = flat/down/no transaction (total = 100%)
m7.seriesUpInfo: Customers whose spending this period is higher than the previous period.
m7.seriesDownInfo: Customers whose spending this period is lower than the previous period.
m7.dialogActiveCountInfo: Number of active customers in the current period, made up of Active Customer and Reactivated customers.
m7.emptyMessage: No expansion data for this period
m7.summaryExistingInfo: Total number of customers who haven't crossed the dormant threshold yet.
m7.summaryTotalPelangganInfo: Total number of all customers who have ever transacted.
m7.summaryDormantInfo: Customers who have transacted before, and have crossed the dormant threshold.
